name: Let's Have One Last Chat
source:
You don't recognize this place, nor the alluring stranger sitting before you. They don't appear to be a threat...so far. All they ask is for a simple chat before you leave. What about you makes them so intrigued?

[From [url=https://eggnoodl23.itch.io/one-last-chat]itch.io[/url]]
